d: Spiky, long indigo hair with long flowing locks trailing behind, featuring short bangs and a pair of red-tinted goggles perched on top. Sharp, narrow crimson eyes with a focused, intense expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a black and orange sleeveless tactical vest over a black crop top, paired with torn black cargo pants and heavy black combat boots. Accessories include black fingerless gloves, a long tattered brown scarf, and a massive, jagged mechanical grey blade.
